items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: In fact Bobby Shew was in Vegas and he came to pick me up and we knew each other, you know, from the NORAD days.

ctx.x: Remember drawing glasses to say “Look out here!” And so I’m watching these guys. So now it gets like 15 minutes before the show and in walks the trumpet player. “God I’m sorry, I was caught in traffic.” And Fisher says, “I don’t care, that’s not an excuse. As you know professional musicians, you’re dead if you’re late. Never be tardy, ever.
